# Wireframe 3D

Structure-first thinking rendered as light technical geometry.

## Use

Use for technical concepts, system architecture introductions, and process prototypes.

## Essential traits

- Wire geometry
- Technical section markers
- Stable solid reading surfaces

## Typography

System monospace for headings; system sans-serif for body.

## Layout and surfaces

Geometric wireframe decoration, thin rules, and structured panels. Cyan-green line grids, technical frames, matte dark content blocks.

## Palette

- background: #081b20
- surface: #102b30
- text: #edfffa
- muted: #aed4cb
- accent: #83ead4
- border: #497e74

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Wireframe 3D to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace for headings; system sans-serif for body. Geometric wireframe decoration, thin rules, and structured panels. Cyan-green line grids, technical frames, matte dark content blocks. Palette: background #081b20, surface #102b30, text #edfffa, muted #aed4cb, accent #83ead4, border #497e74. Essential traits: Wire geometry; Technical section markers; Stable solid reading surfaces. Avoid: Lines crossing text; Overly dense meshes; Decorative measurements presented as real data. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
